title: phase-u: Strict managed sc-lint adoption and frozen dependency carry-in
description:
## Goal
Adopt strict managed sc-lint 0.8.5, carry the approved dependency work and existing function seams onto an explicitly selected recovered base, and deliver the committed 1.8.0 CLI-reference and stable-ABI wheel work. Base is TBD by lead/user (D6); origin/develop caa43cfca893f81724d30719c8de820c9f8567fd is an observed contaminated head, NOT presumed clean. The recovery owner works independently; this is final plan round 2 of 2.

## Sprint set
| Sprint | Scope | Hard prerequisites | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| U.1 | Base decision/provenance and sole frozen 18-row carry-in checklist | D6 lead/user base decision before landing | recovery-approved base + CI exit3 settlement |
| U.2 | Strict policy and canonical identity fixtures | U.1 | D1/D2 user decisions; 0.8.4 evidence sufficient |
| U.3 | Accept existing CLI seams, 8 commits | U.1 | reuse completed work |
| U.4 | Accept existing Beads seams, 6 commits | U.1 | reuse completed work |
| U.5 | Accept existing composer seams, 11 commits | U.1 | reuse completed work |
| U.6 | Windows cross rows/provisioning | U.2 | transitional explicit PyO3 version; U.9 later removes interpreter-version need |
| U.7 | Managed 0.8.5 kit/pin/adapter/CI migration | U.6 | actually published 0.8.5 kit/native/wheel |
| U.8 | #648 deterministic CLI reference/installer/website | U.7 | existing required 1.8.0 scope |
| U.9 | #820 ABI build, Python 3.9 audit, limited API and xwin rows | U.8 (soft planned order) | PyO3 0.30/#829; D4/D5 |
| U.10 | #820 built-wheel 24-cell pip/uv matrix, local-index rehearsal and preflight | U.9 | exact U.9 wheel artifacts; no publish |
| U.11 | Combined acceptance, whole-phase ending review and develop handoff | U.3,U.4,U.5,U.10 | complete exact-head strict/CI/wheel proofs; D7 proposed compat gate |

U.1 contains the only frozen PR checklist. All 25 existing function refactors at ab07145be770ec2e1140840814bde778ab0288eb (based on #841) are reused, not recreated. Original QA and old/new provenance survive recovery replay; no claim those old trees are already clean-base integrated. #842 documentation must also survive. No sprint publishes; release 1.8.0 is after Phase U.

## Open decisions — NOT approved defaults
D1 OPEN: propose [line_counts] max_production_lines=1000, no exclusions;175 files passed, max807. User must decide before U.2 closes.
D2 OPEN: propose exact forbidden test literals randlee/team-lead/arch-comp/arch-ccomp/comp/comps/team-lead@example.invalid/ATM_HOME, no production owner for those; canonical owners for SC_COMPOSE_DATA_DIR and SC_COMPOSE_TEMPLATE_DIR in template_store.rs, and SC_COMPOSE_TEMPLATE_CONTRACTS_SCOPE in commands/template_lint.rs. Policy input and identity/boundary test drivers consume ONE canonical non-Rust JSON fixture. repo_boundaries.rs:206 must load ATM_HOME from it, not concat! or a lint exemption. User must approve before encoding/closure. No policy is presumed approved and no justified exception is currently proposed.

D3 OPEN — #787: is the already QM-reviewed additive opt-in e8143961 within the approved small-fix scope? Original default-on 588ab3d7 must not ship unchanged; otherwise omit/defer #787. No approval inferred from old QA.
D4 OPEN — #820 floor: confirm CPython >=3.9 (issue-requested floor, NOT presumed approved by this plan); U.9 records the selected floor before implementing/tagging wheels.
D5 OPEN — #820 package scope: do sc-sha-python and sc-composer-beads-python also migrate to abi3? Core sc-compose is the requested commitment; other packages stay explicitly undecided until user disposition.
D6 OPEN — lead/user base choice: A, revert-forward recovery PR lands on develop first and integrate/phase-u is cut from the recorded corrected develop head; OR B, authorized rebuild of integrate/phase-u from v1.7.0 plus approved replay. Neither route is selected here; caa43cfc is not a clean baseline.
D7 OPEN — proposed v1.7.0 backward-compatibility gate in U.11 NEEDS USER APPROVAL: Rust/Python public API and CLI surface diff, overlay v1.7.0 test suites, schema-less rendering byte identity. Do not claim this proposed extra gate is already authorized or passed.

## 1.8.0 issue ledger
| Issue | Disposition / sprint | Closure accounting |
|---|---|---|
| [#648](https://github.com/randlee/sc-compose/issues/648) — Clap-generated CLI reference in installer and website | REQUIRED, U.8 | U.11 verifies deterministic manual, installed offline payload and matching navigable website; existing commitment retained |
| [#817](https://github.com/randlee/sc-compose/issues/817) — maintained YAML / RUSTSEC-2024-0449 | REQUIRED, U.1 carries already-built #839 | U.11 verifies approved repair and final dependency graph; no waiver or new parser redesign |
| [#820](https://github.com/randlee/sc-compose/issues/820) — stable-ABI wheels | REQUIRED, U.9 + U.10 | cp39-abi3 core wheels, Python audit, limited-API compile and 3.9–3.14 install/import matrix; D4/D5 explicitly OPEN |
| [#819](https://github.com/randlee/sc-compose/issues/819) — CPython 3.14 wheels | SUPERSEDED by #820; no separate sprint | Superseded, close when #820 lands; no separate cp314-only deliverable |
Planned issue labels are planned/1.8.0 NOW; released/1.8.0 only at actual publish after Phase U. These are lifecycle requirements, not claims this local task changed remote labels or published anything. No publish/release sprint exists.

## Ledger candidates — user triage pending, NOT committed sprints
One read of gh issue list --state open supplied the following candidates. Titles are evidence of reported defects, not fresh reproduction or an approved fix commitment.
| Issue | Reported defect / triage question |
|---|---|
| #169 | Quadratic rejection latency for deeply nested var-file input |
| #601 | release-preflight package-check-plan generator crash silently passes |
| #615 | Bead render rejects missing .beads/formulas directory |
| #818 | frontmatter-init relative --file fails with empty canonicalized root |
| #611 | Wheel compatibility/platform coverage; overlap with #820, with macOS Intel/Windows ARM requests outside #820's current four-platform matrix |
| #505 | Release notes template not consumed by automation |
| #502 | Release-note included-packages table missing sc-sha and Scoop |
| #357 | temp_root non-RAII leaks reported across test files |
| #240 | Config parse diagnostics lack path/line/column attribution |
| #361 | Old sc-lint boundary helper cargo-runs absent consumer package; triage whether U.7 resolves it, not a new sprint |
These remain candidates until user triage; no auto-close, label change or scope admission. #613/#614 are already labeled shipped/1.7.0 in the issue listing and are not newly scheduled defects. #503 is an ATM ownership report, not admitted to this standalone toolchain.

## Follow-on prose only
Held toml1, quick-xml0.42, MiniJinja3, clap/serde/thiserror and duplicate-version upgrades remain out of scope; no reserved sprint numbers. No advisory/Clippy/identity/size exception is authorized. No 1.7.1 metadata/changelog wholesale replay.
design:
## Boundary map
- BOUNDARY-ScCompose owns sc-lint process invocation/normalization/report HTML and root developer orchestration; sc-lint owns rules and envelopes. Preserve fixed executable/allowlisted descriptors (ADR0016/0017).
- BOUNDARY-ScComposer stays pure: private completed composition/extraction/schema changes preserve API/diagnostic/span semantics; no CLI/ATM dependencies.
- BOUNDARY-ScComposerBeads retains host-neutral argv/receipts/graph/quoting; no test-support dependency reintroduction (ADR0021/0023).
- Directed edges stay CLI->composer/beads, beads->composer, composer->sc-sha, Python/Go adapters->owned libraries. Inventory corrections#836, Zlib removal#837, dev-edge removal#838, YAML advisory repair#839, generator repair#840 and stale workspace cleanup#841 are finished inputs, not new scope.

## Delivery and authorized writers — base gate, then two landing stages
D6 is an explicit lead/user gate, not an implementation guess. Route A: the recovery owner lands an approved revert-forward PR onto develop; lead records the corrected develop SHA/tree and cuts integrate/phase-u after it. Route B: the authorized recovery writer rebuilds integrate/phase-u from v1.7.0=f4fda4b9 plus the approved replay selection, with original acf55fba/tree ab9c9c02 only a recorded starting candidate; settle #787 without unchanged default-on behavior. Preserve the existing recovery epic rather than rederive it. In either route record exact ancestry/head/tree, approved scope, authorizations and source/replay mappings before accepting U.1. No ordinary merge of quarantined strict-only ancestry, and no treating caa43cfc as clean.
After that base gate and CI exit3 settlement, comp is authorized to land the frozen #831 plus 17 #825 rows EARLY onto integrate/phase-u, with #831 below dependency content. They do not wait for U.11. One active writer; lead coordinates authorized replay/relink and records original/new heads and content conflicts. Existing frozen layers are not silently rewritten by this planner; recovery-driven adaptations require the recovery owner's explicit dispositions and fresh affected QA. Retain #842 docs alongside the 25-commit function branch based on #841. Every row is landed or explicitly dropped before closure.
Intermediate CI: #836 inventory versus pinned 0.4.0 makes Set up lint toolchain exit3; classify that before early landing and resolve it in U.7. No disabled rule or final green claim.
Final handoff is lead/user controlled. For A, sync the whole phase only onto the approved corrected develop lineage. For B, explicitly reconcile the clean rebuilt integration lineage with develop under the lead/user's approved recovery landing method; do not rebase or merge contaminated develop back into it. Freeze exact source/target heads, record endpoint tree diff AND replay/ancestry mapping (a triple-dot merge-base diff alone can hide rebuilt-history scope), then rerun affected final proofs if candidate changes. U.11 PASS plus user go-ahead gates the sole phase-to-develop PR. No stack mutation is part of this local plan revision.

## Sanity and closure
Per explicit lead ruling, dev-sanity is read-only numbered-deliverable verification, no lint execution and not QA. Global strict debt does not block independent completed seam acceptance. Only U.11 owns final aggregate green and the full-phase ending review; only develop integration and phase closure wait for that final gate. Carry-in landing on integrate/phase-u is explicitly permitted EARLY after the exit3 settlement. No phase closes with an unaccounted U.1 PR or incomplete1.8.0 issue ledger. Groups/QA are poured later by the installed orchestrator, not created manually here.

## Release and technical contract
0.8.5 is an explicit release gate, not assumed published. Confirm kit/native/wheel versions, helper policy/default profile/logging/artifacts support, corrected managed Python PATH, ARM64 support and packaged pytests fix from the actual released artifact before U.7/U.11. Retain packaged pytests; do not omit it to pass0.8.4. The sc-lint lead confirmed work lint-085.18/QA lint-085.19; research handoffs are in /Users/randlee/.codex/reports/sc-lint-0.8.4-adoption-plan-20261103/upstream-confirmed-reply*.txt.
Analyzer exit10 keeps ok:true/data.findings; helper exit5 has ok:false/error.details.findings, capped10 plus true findings_count. Preserve raw exit/envelope and true totals. Config errors3/usage2/profile.steps_failed failed_steps[{index,name,exit_code,message,step_log_destination?,step_log_error?}]. Version uses data.version+self_contained. Never let the consumer reporter's legacy Findings exit0 make a strict gate green.

## Waves/ownership
U.2/U.3/U.4/U.5 consume U.1 with disjoint implementation/verification fences. U.6 consumes policy; U.7 consumes cross declarations; U.8 consumes managed CI. U.9-after-U.8 is SOFT planned staging-manifest reuse order (not intrinsic ABI-build coupling), retained in the index; if U.8 slips, lead explicitly revises order/PR lower bounds rather than silently bypassing it. U.10 HARD-consumes U.9's exact built wheels and decisions, then U.11 accepts all. Planned critical path 8 (U.1->U.2->U.6->U.7->U.8->U.9->U.10->U.11), width 4, sprint count 11. Original completed work is reused; actual append order remains one-writer controlled. No extra roots or assignees in metadata.

The committed docs/phase-u/beads-plan.jsonl is the frozen pre-import payload for lead review/import, not an alternate runtime plan. Vars/partial renders stay outside the repo. After confirmed import, Beads is authoritative and this snapshot is historical import evidence; no parallel Markdown sprint docs or synchronization process are introduced.
## Additional CLI documentation delivery boundary
U.8/#648 adds CLI-owned deterministic reference tooling based on the actual Clap command tree, with offline installer Markdown and static site/ output as two consumers of ONE generation result. Retain existing embedded conceptual manuals (FR-22), command grammar and pure-library boundaries. No new parser definitions, handwritten option inventory or held Clap-version upgrade is authorized by this scope. Release1.8.0 preparation regenerates both and CI/release rejects missing/stale output. This is a single user-required integration sprint; no extra ceremony or split publishing project.

## Stable ABI delivery boundaries — applied QM split
U.9 owns #820 ABI build, Python 3.9 audit, limited-API compile/symbol checks and xwin rows without PYO3_CROSS_PYTHON_VERSION for approved migrated packages; D4/D5 gate implementation. U.10 consumes those exact built artifacts for 24-cell pip/uv install/import, local-index rehearsal with negative fixtures and preflight wiring. Both are required for #820, then U.11 alone updates the issue ledger and verifies combined acceptance. No TestPyPI/PyPI publication. Non-abi3 sibling cross prerequisites remain explicitly scoped until D5; no blanket removal. This mechanical split applies quality-mgr's one finding from final round 2; no third review round.

title: u-8: generated-cli-reference
description:
## Issue/release
Issue#648: https://github.com/randlee/sc-compose/issues/648 — Next release: ship Clap-generated CLI reference in installer and website. REQUIRED release1.8.0 scope, not optional follow-on. Existing feature manuals are conceptual and embedded; Pages currently deploys static site/. This sprint creates deterministic executable tooling and its installed/web delivery, retaining those manuals.
## Deliverables
1. Add deterministic tooling that traverses the ACTUAL Clap command tree derived from cli/schema.rs through CommandFactory, including every public nested subcommand, usage, options/global options, defaults, possible values and available long help/examples. Generate content from definitions only; agents may improve source help/attribution, never author a second reference option list. Hidden/internal tooling is excluded by Clap visibility semantics; current conceptual help/manuals remain available and unchanged in role.
2. Provide developer/release command just generate-cli-reference mode="write" (or check), using one generator output model for BOTH a versioned Markdown manual crates/sc-compose/docs/reference/sc-compose-<release-version>.md and equivalent navigable site/manual/cli-reference.html. Both identify the same release version and cover the same command inventory; stable command-path anchors, a table of contents and accessible website navigation expose every public command. No timestamps, host paths, locale or terminal-width randomness.
3. Ship the versioned Markdown with release assets AND installer-managed payloads, accessible offline at a documented share/sc-compose/manual location. Extend consumer-owned release manifest/template/input bundled_paths so all declared archives and applicable installer channels preserve the manual; validate an extracted/installed package offline, not just a repository file. Retain existing conceptual manuals and examples. Do not edit duplicated vendored sc-publish internals; use supported consumer inputs/generated surfaces and escalate any upstream capability gap rather than forking release tooling.
4. Release preparation automatically regenerates BOTH outputs for the actual release version from the same Clap definitions BEFORE artifact staging, and CI/release validation rejects missing/stale/wrong-version/incomplete outputs. Consume U.7's managed aggregate profile contract to add the deterministic check; regeneration is a required release step, not a manual reminder. Pages continues serving static site/ with explicit navigation to the matching reference; no separate handwritten website option inventory.
5. Attach coverage/equivalence/stale-negative/package-install/offline/navigation proof; keep issue#648 OPEN/pending until its acceptance is met and accounted for in final Phase U review. No release publish/deploy is performed merely by completing this plan.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Actual Clap-tree inventory equals generated Markdown AND HTML inventory: every public command/subcommand, usage, option/default/allowed value and available help/example is represented. Deterministic fixed-input generation twice yields identical bytes; meaningful schema mutation (new option/default/subcommand) proves the stale check fails until regeneration. No sleeps/event-loop/order-based tests and no manually maintained second option list.
2. just generate-cli-reference write && just generate-cli-reference check pass; cargo test --workspace and targeted CLI-reference coverage/equivalence/escaping tests pass. Existing conceptual sc-compose help/manual tests still pass. CI check mode exits nonzero for missing Markdown, missing HTML, stale Clap metadata or wrong release version, without silently regenerating away a failure.
3. Release preparation invokes the generator for the release version and fails before archive/upload if either output is absent/stale. Fixture-based archive/installer validation extracts/installs declared payloads and locates/read-checks the versioned Markdown offline at the documented installed path; supported channel manifests preserve it. No production release publication is needed for these controlled checks.
4. Website page heading/version/anchors correspond to that SAME generated manual, all links resolve within static site/, and site/index.html navigation exposes it. A packaged1.8.0 release fixture and website reference both identify1.8.0. Final U.11 verifies#648 together with#817 in the1.8.0 issue ledger and full-phase diff. Release1.8.0 may not omit this issue's deliverables.

title: u-9: stable-abi-wheels
description:
## Issue/release and decisions
#820 https://github.com/randlee/sc-compose/issues/820 spans U.9 build and U.10 install validation; both are REQUIRED for 1.8.0. #819 is superseded, close when #820 lands. D4 OPEN: confirm requested CPython >=3.9 floor; D5 OPEN: do sc-sha-python and sc-composer-beads-python also go abi3? This sprint does not close #820 alone. No publishing.
## Deliverables
1. For issue #820 (FR-8 constrains deterministic results/diagnostics), after D4/D5 disposition add pyo3 abi3-py39 to sc-compose-py on the carried PyO3 0.30/#829 layer, set requires-python >=3.9 and matching metadata/classifiers if confirmed. Keep extension-module wheel linkage separate from normal Rust tests. Produce cp39-abi3 wheels for macOS arm64, manylinux aarch64, manylinux x86_64 and Windows amd64, with exact candidate/artifact hashes for U.10. Frozen #829 is not edited. If floor changes, record revised explicit tag/matrix criteria under user decision first; never claim cp39 using another floor. No new Windows ARM/macOS Intel commitment.
2. Audit bindings/python/python and stubs for Python 3.9 compatibility: runtime tomllib, evaluated X|Y annotations, imported typing APIs and packaging constraints. Use compatibility code/dependencies only where actual 3.9 execution requires it; test package import/annotations/stubs at the selected floor. Audit sibling metadata/Python/extension sources only if D5 admits them; otherwise their ABI policy remains explicit and unchanged.
3. Compile all selected extension modules with PyO3 0.30 limited API enabled and inspect symbols/tags for accidental non-limited APIs. Run cargo check -p sc-compose-py --features pyo3/abi3-py39, cargo test --workspace and built-wheel binding regressions; equivalent sibling checks are conditional on D5. A filename alone is not ABI proof. Hand U.10 the built wheels, hashes and selected floor/package decisions; the 24-cell install matrix and index rehearsal belong to U.10.
4. Revisit U.6 Windows xwin check/clippy rows: prove both WITHOUT PYO3_CROSS_PYTHON_VERSION for every migrated package and remove its need from that scoped config. If siblings remain interpreter-specific, retain only their required provisioning/setting and explicitly record the residual workspace need. Preserve MSVC/GNU/LinuxARM64 coverage and existing Python APIs/defaults; #787 remains independent D3. Attach final cross evidence to U.11.
design:
The ABI build boundary owns binding Cargo/pyproject files, Python runtime/stubs, limited-API compile evidence and final xwin declarations. It hands exact built/hashed wheel artifacts to U.10, which alone owns the full install matrix/rehearsal/preflight validation. No composer redesign or ATM dependencies; sibling paths are conditional on D5.
FR-8 governs deterministic composition/diagnostics in binding regressions. No ADR defines the ABI3 floor; issue #820 and D4/D5 define that packaging contract. Example after floor confirmation: pyo3 = { version = "0.30", features = ["abi3-py39"] }; requires-python = ">=3.9"; wheel tag cp39-abi3-<platform>. Keep extension-module a separate maturin wheel feature; never downgrade #829 or silently flip sibling features.
U.9-after-U.8 is a SOFT planning dependency for reuse of U.8's settled generated-manual staging manifest/pre-upload contract, not an intrinsic ABI build prerequisite. The current index conservatively keeps that order; if U.8 slips, the lead may explicitly revise order/PR lower bounds under normal authorization, never silently bypass the index. U.10 has the hard dependency on this sprint's built wheels. U.6 finishes pre-ABI rows first, U.9 updates them as a new layer. No 24-cell/install-rehearsal acceptance is claimed here.
acceptance_criteria:
1. D4 floor and D5 package scope explicitly decided before implementation/closure. All selected bindings have matching PyO3 0.30 ABI feature, metadata and Python/stub floor-audit evidence; requested target is >=3.9/cp39-abi3, not assumed approval.
2. cargo check -p sc-compose-py --features pyo3/abi3-py39 and cargo test --workspace pass; actual limited-API compile/symbol/tag checks and built-wheel binding regressions pass. Include selected sibling checks only under D5. No public API removals/default changes.
3. The four-platform wheel artifact set is built once, versioned and hashed against the recorded candidate, ready for U.10. Completing build checks is not a claim that the 24-cell install matrix passed or #820 is closed.
4. Final U.6-derived xwin check AND clippy rows pass without PYO3_CROSS_PYTHON_VERSION for migrated packages; any unmigrated sibling requirement is explicitly scoped. U.10 owns full built-wheel install/rehearsal/preflight acceptance; U.11 owns final ledger update. No publish.

title: u-10: wheel-install-validation
description:
## Issue/release and prerequisite
#820 REQUIRED 1.8.0 scope is shared with U.9; #819 is superseded, close when #820 lands. Consume U.9's exact built/hashed four-platform wheels and explicit D4/D5 floor/package decisions; do not rebuild different artifacts in install cells. This sprint owns install/preflight validation, not ABI feature implementation or publication.
## Deliverables
1. Run the built-wheel install/import matrix for EVERY CPython 3.9,3.10,3.11,3.12,3.13,3.14 on EACH of macOS arm64, manylinux aarch64, manylinux x86_64 and Windows amd64: 24 core cells, adjusted only by an explicit D4 floor decision. Both pip and uv wheel-only resolution/install must succeed without a Rust toolchain, source-tree import or sdist fallback. Import sc_compose, verify native-extension identity and run representative deterministic composition smoke outside checkout. Record actual interpreter/platform/tag and resolved artifact hash. No unavailable/skipped cell counts as PASS; use native runners/controlled containers/VMs with the requested interpreter. Extend packages only if D5 selects siblings.
2. Add a TestPyPI-style REHEARSAL using those same built wheels, metadata and a disposable local simple-index/artifact staging service. Verify clean pip/uv wheel-only resolution/install/import for staged versioned artifacts. No TestPyPI/PyPI upload, tokens, release tags, public deployment or publishing. Controlled fixtures reject missing platform wheels, incompatible tag/floor and source fallback; no sleeps/load/event-order reliance.
3. Wire matrix/artifact completeness and compatibility checks into preflight/CI through supported consumer manifest/template inputs, consuming U.8's settled generated-manual staging/pre-upload contract and U.9 wheels. Reject incomplete/incompatible staging before publication; no vendored publisher edits or actual publication.
4. Hand U.11 exact candidate/artifact hashes, all installer/matrix outcomes, negative-fixture and rehearsal evidence. #820 acceptance requires both U.9 and U.10; U.11 alone updates the phase issue ledger. This sprint does not relabel/close issues, publish, or claim the final phase acceptance.
design:
This boundary consumes U.9's wheel artifact set, ABI/floor/package decisions and hashes; it implements installer/index/preflight checks without modifying ABI source or Python defaults. It depends HARD on U.9's artifacts. vertical_rationale: thin wheel-validation tooling plus its consumer preflight/CI wiring, closing the observed #820 installation defect through the real built artifacts. FR-8 governs deterministic smoke results/diagnostic stability; no existing ADR defines this packaging validation.
Matrix record: {package, candidate_sha, artifact_sha256, wheel_tag, os_arch, python_version, installer, install_exit, import_exit, native_module_path, smoke_result}; require pip and uv results in every core cell and selected sibling cell. Installed native module must resolve inside the fresh environment outside checkout, with no cargo/rustc available. Local-index rehearsal mirrors staged-index resolution, sends no data to a registry and uses controlled inputs/process results for deterministic negative checks. All source build/limited-API/xwin work remains U.9; U.11 performs final combined acceptance and ledger update.
acceptance_criteria:
1. For all four platform architectures x six CPython versions, pip AND uv install ONLY U.9's staged built wheel and import/use the installed native module outside checkout without Rust tools. All 24 core cells pass, with actual interpreter/platform/tag/hash recorded, no sdist/source fallback or skipped cells. Apply explicitly selected D4/D5 floor/sibling disposition, never an assumed narrower matrix.
2. Controlled local-index TestPyPI-style rehearsal passes with the same artifacts; missing/incompatible wheel and fallback-negative fixtures fail deterministically. No remote upload/publish/deploy/tag. Preflight rejects incomplete or incompatible staging before publication.
3. cargo test --workspace and targeted deterministic wheel-matrix/rehearsal/preflight fixtures pass. Actual native artifact install/import evidence is required in addition to fixture tests; no Rust build-only substitute.
4. U.11 receives complete #820 U.9+U.10 evidence for final ledger accounting; #819 stays superseded until #820 lands. Planned/released label lifecycle remains final-ledger accounting in U.11; no issue updates or publish performed here.
